brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.

requirements.requirement: Compact desk unit with a drawer
requirements.evidence: 4 bases: 3 full (0,0,0; 0,1,0; 1,0,0) forming compact cluster plus half-n at 0,-1,0 providing desk surface; drawer drawer:0#0,-1#cut fitted to half-n cut face (s slot). Mesh clear.

requirements.requirement: Spike at corner where three bases meet holding small platform
requirements.evidence: Spike spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 (mount variant) placed at junction of the three full bases (0,0|0,1|1,0) with accessory platform-sm attached via setSpikeAccessory.

finish.summary: Built compact desk: 3 full hex bases in triangular cluster plus half-n extension with drawer. Mount spike at the central three-base junction carries small platform (platform-sm). check_build meshClash clear.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
